Hi Tom, it's Claire. I'm at the airport in São Paulo, and I want to give you a quick update. The visit was the best business trip of my year. The meeting on Tuesday was not as short as our meetings in Chicago, but it was very productive. Rafael told me that the relationship was the most important part of a deal, and now I understand why. The contract for the next season was finalized on Wednesday, and it was signed by both directors. We also talked about the damaged boxes in Rotterdam. The root cause was found: the container was too warm. I think we should use the same backup plan for every shipment. Why don't we call Rafael together next Monday? See you tomorrow.

Hi Rafael, this is Paulo from the plant with some good news. The new part arrived on Thursday, and the machine was fixed the same day. The production line was opened again on Friday morning. Our output this week was lower than normal, but the two clients were not affected. Their orders were sent from the other warehouse, and both clients told us they were happy with the solution. I think this was the fastest repair of the year. Next month, the old machines should be checked by the technicians, so we don't have the same issue again. How about meeting on Wednesday to plan it? Call me back when you can.

First, the client in Rotterdam sent a complaint about the damaged boxes. Then, the root cause was found: the container was too warm. Next, Claire visited Picunha, and Rafael explained Brazilian business customs. After that, the contract was finalized and signed by both directors. Finally, Rafael told the board that it was the best week of the quarter.
